title: Hadrian header
description: A fixed navy bar: a wide uppercase wordmark left, a centred strip of hairline-boxed mono cells showing local times at each plant, and a square MENU box right that opens a full-width link panel. It slides up out of view once you scroll down past half a screen and drops back in when you scroll up.
notes: fixed to the top: the first section needs its own top padding (76px phones, 100px desktop)
the clock strip shows from 768px; each cell with a timeZone ticks every 30s once hydrated, the static HTML shows the given times
needs JavaScript for the hide-on-scroll, the clocks and the menu
name: hadrian-header

props.name: brand
props.description: the company name, set as the wordmark

props.name: clocks
props.description: the centred strip of local times (hidden on phones)

props.name: menuLabel
props.description: text of the menu toggle when closed, e.g. "Menu"

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: text of the menu toggle when open, e.g. "Close"

props.name: hideAfter
props.description: how far down (in window heights) the page must scroll before the bar slides away
